newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation quickens to 0.7 percent in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation quickens to 0.7 percent in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have accelerated in the week ended January 27 to 0.7 percent from 0.4 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended Jan 27 Jan 20
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +1.1 +1.1
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data, but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
